description: Attention a subject gets now, from the official Wikimedia pageviews API: items[] {topic, article, url, views_last_day, avg_7d, change_7d_pct, avg_30d, change_30d_pct, trend rising|falling|steady, peak_60d, daily_30d[]}, ranked by avg_7d. Up to 5 topics (comma-separated), lang en/pt/es…. $0.002/call. Use to see how much attention topics get now (Wikipedia pageviews, 7d/30d change, rising or falling) before choosing what content to make.
name: topic_demand
title: Topic demand (Wikipedia pageviews)
